description: Example bounded PR review lineage (#1518 Phase 1) modeled on the jinwon-int/a2a-nexus#1582 trusted-author slice. Public-safe: SHAs reference the public repo; no secrets, endpoints, or runtime files.

intentContract.goal: Carry a dispatcher-declared trusted author identity into review-independence validation so self-contained review tasks no longer fail review_not_independent (#1548).
nonGoals: No change to finalizer verdict, CodeQL, or required-check gates
No automatic acceptance of reviewer-authored changes
invariants: Absent authorWorkerId keeps the legacy claimedBy/assignedWorkerId/targetNodeId fallback byte-identical
Malformed review payload fails closed as review_evidence_missing

acceptanceCriteria.text: Self-contained review task with declared different author passes independence validation
Declared author equal to the reviewer is rejected as review_not_independent
Absent authorWorkerId preserves legacy fallback behavior
Malformed or blank authorWorkerId fails closed as review_evidence_missing

reviewReceipt.note: Independent review of the trusted-author slice: fail-closed parsing, preserved fallback, broker-terminal gate no longer shadows the payload declaration.

samplePatch:
diff --git a/packages/broker/src/worker-review.ts b/packages/broker/src/worker-review.ts
index 4d64a54..90f9ee2 100644
--- a/packages/broker/src/worker-review.ts
+++ b/packages/broker/src/worker-review.ts
@@ -69,7 +69,7 @@
-  const authorId = (authorWorkerId ?? task.claimedBy ?? task.assignedWorkerId ?? task.targetNodeId ?? "").trim();
+  const authorId = (authorWorkerId ?? parsed.spec.authorWorkerId ?? task.claimedBy ?? task.assignedWorkerId ?? task.targetNodeId ?? "").trim();
